WITH 
-- Calculate the number of customers per segment for each year
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('year', Date) AS Year,
        Segment,
        COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate total consumption per customer per year
total_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Year
),
-- Calculate annual average consumption per customer per segment
avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        Segment,
        ROUND(TotalConsumption.TotalConsumption / COUNT(*), 2) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM total_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the lowest consumption per segment per year
lowest_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Year,
        Segment,
        MIN(Consumption) AS LowestConsumption
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date >= '201301' AND Date <= '201312'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual average between SME and LAM for each segment
diff_sme_lam AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS SME_Avg,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS LAM_Avg
    FROM avg_consumption
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual average between LAM and KAM for each segment
diff_lam_kam AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS LAM_Avg,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS KAM_Avg
    FROM avg_consumption
    WHERE Segment IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
),
-- Calculate the difference in annual average between KAM and SME for each segment
diff_kam_sme AS (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS KAM_Avg,
        AVG(avg_consumption.AnnualAverage) AS SME_Avg
    FROM avg_consumption
    WHERE Segment IN ('KAM', 'SME')
    GROUP BY Year, Segment
)
SELECT 
    'Between 201301 And 201312' AS DateRange,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN (SELECT SME_Avg FROM diff_sme_lam) > (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam) THEN (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam) - (SELECT SME_Avg FROM diff_sme_lam)
            WHEN (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam) > (SELECT SME_Avg FROM diff_sme_lam) THEN (SELECT SME_Avg FROM diff_sme_lam) - (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam)
            ELSE (SELECT SME_Avg FROM diff_sme_lam) - (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam)
        END, 2) AS AnnualAvgDifference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        Year,
        Segment,
        (SELECT SME_Avg FROM diff_sme_lam) - (SELECT LAM_Avg FROM diff_lam_kam) AS Difference
    FROM diff_sme_lam
    JOIN diff_lam_kam ON Year = Year AND Segment = Segment
)
WHERE DateRange = 'Between 201301 And 201312'
ORDER BY Difference DESC

    event e ON b.event_status = 'event' AND e.event_id = e.event_id

    m.first_name = 'Elijah Allen'

    AND e.expense_date LIKE '%09%' OR e.expense_date LIKE '%10%'
GROUP BY 
    e.cost
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 0

SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.status,
    e.type,
    e.notes,
    e.location,
    e.event_date,
    b.amount,

FROM event e

WHERE e.status = 'Closed'

HAVING (b.spent / b.amount) > 0
ORDER BY max_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as TotalPatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as InpatientPatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as OutpatientPatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as MaleInpatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as MaleOutpatients,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100,
        2
    ) as MaleDeviationPercentage
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M'
GROUP BY Admission, SEX
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

    d.forename AS driverName,
    d.surname AS driverSurname,
    r.name AS raceName,

sql:
WITH shortest_lap_times AS (
    SELECT
        r.raceId,
        r.driverId,
        r.time,
        r.lap,
        r.position,
        r.milliseconds,
        r.fastestLapTime,
        r.fastestLapSpeed,
        d.forename,
        d.surname
    FROM races r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.lap = (
        SELECT MIN(lap)
        FROM lapTimes lt
        WHERE lt.raceId = r.raceId
        AND lt.driverId = r.driverId
    )
),
top_20_drivers AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        driverName
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY driverName ASC
    LIMIT 20
)
SELECT
    s.forename,
    s.surname
FROM shortest_lap_times s
JOIN top_20_drivers td ON s.driverId = td.driverId

    SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_superheroes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN superpower ON superpower.id = hero_power.power_id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')

    c.name,
    c.artist,
    c.isPromo
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE 
    c.uuid IN (
        SELECT r.uuid
        FROM rulings r
        GROUP BY r.uuid
        HAVING COUNT(*) = (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM rulings r2
            WHERE r2.uuid = r.uuid
        )
    )
GROUP BY 
    c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    c.name,

    c.isPromo
FROM 
    cards c

        FROM rulings r
        GROUP BY r.uuid

JOIN account a ON c.client_id = a.account_id
